---
title: "JuliaBayes"
description: "JuliaBayes is a shared home for Bayesian software in Julia."
toc: false
include-in-header: theming/hero-fonts.html
# Quarto loads MathJax on every listing page. The landing page shows no maths.
html-math-method: plain
# The landing page shares the site theme, so that the next page needs no new
# stylesheet. Its own rules hang off this class.
body-classes: landing
listing:
  - id: news-listing
    contents: news/posts
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 9
    type: default
    fields: [date, title]
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
  # The template keeps the ecosystem page's order and its row limit, since
  # `max-items` would also count the release entries.
  - id: packages-overview
    contents: [ecosystem/packages.yml, ecosystem/releases.yml]
    template: ecosystem/overview.ejs.md
    sort: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
---
